tool_input.content:
---
name: project_validation_pipeline
description: Content validation pipeline — validator agent proofreads JSON files, fix-schema-issues.mjs fixes structural bugs, sync pushes to Firestore
type: project
---

Content quality pipeline for proofreading and fixing the 413 bilingual content JSON files.

**Why:** Phase 1 content was LLM-generated at scale. Validation ensures Korean tone (해요체/합니다체), SEO field lengths, schema completeness, and English localization quality before Vercel deploy.

**How to apply:** Run validator on a category, run fix-schema-issues.mjs for structural fixes, then sync to Firestore. Do not skip the sync step — local JSON and Firestore must stay in sync.

## Pipeline
1. `content-validator-agent` — fixes metaDescription lengths and prose tone in place, writes `data/validation/report-{category}-{batch}-{timestamp}.json`
2. `node scripts/fix-schema-issues.mjs [--dry-run]` — bulk structural fixes (content→body, relatedDreams→seo.relatedSlugs). Safe to re-run.
3. Review: `cat data/validation/report-*.json | jq '.summary'`
4. Sync (few changes): `node scripts/sync-changed-to-firestore.mjs --latest [--dry-run]`
   Sync (many changes): `node scripts/migrate-content-to-firestore.mjs [--dry-run]`

## metaDescription Targets (CRITICAL)
- **Korean: 80–110 chars** — Korean chars are visually ~2x wide. Do NOT use 120–160 for Korean.
- **English: 120–160 chars**

## Batch Rules
- **10 agents max per batch** for validation (no API calls, CPU-bound)
- **6 agents max per batch** for content generation (rate-limited by Imagen 4 API)
- Validator caps at 20 files per invocation — chunk large categories:
  - actions (161 files): 8 agent runs
  - animals (~29 files): 2 agent runs
  - all other categories (9-10 files): 1 agent run each

## Phase 1 Validation — COMPLETE ✅ (2026-03-14)
All 413 files across 24 categories validated and fixed:
- metaDescription lengths corrected everywhere
- `content`→`body` renamed in sections/variations (315 files) — was causing blank text
- `relatedDreams`→`seo.relatedSlugs` migrated (315 files) — was causing empty related dreams
- Firestore re-synced: all 413 docs via migrate-content-to-firestore.mjs

## Key Files
- Agent: `.claude/agents/content-validator-agent.md`
- Bulk fix: `scripts/fix-schema-issues.mjs`
- Sync (partial): `scripts/sync-changed-to-firestore.mjs`
- Full sync: `scripts/migrate-content-to-firestore.mjs`
- Reports output: `data/validation/report-{category}-{batch}-{ISO-timestamp}.json`
- Firestore collection: `dreams`, doc ID = english slug
